lessons.title: Adverbs of Frequency: always, usually, often, sometimes, hardly ever, never
lessons.content: We use adverbs of frequency to say if something happens often or not. The usual position is before the main verb. Adverbs of frequency go after the verb to be.

details.explanation: The adverbs of frequency from most to least: always (100%), usually, often, sometimes, hardly ever, never (0%).
details.example: I always do my homework. I usually go to the theatre. I never dance.
details.burmese: Adverbs of frequency တွေက ဘယ်လောက် မကြာခဏ ဖြစ်တယ်ဆိုတာ ပြောပါတယ်။ always (100%) ကနေ never (0%) ထိ ရှိပါတယ်။

details.explanation: Place adverbs of frequency before the main verb in a sentence.
details.example: I always do my homework. I usually go to the theatre. I hardly ever go out with my friends.
details.burmese: Adverbs of frequency ကို main verb ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။

details.explanation: Place adverbs of frequency after the verb to be (am, is, are, was, were).
details.example: I am often relaxed. I am sometimes late for class.
details.burmese: Adverbs of frequency ကို verb to be (am, is, are, was, were) ပြီးနောက်မှာ ထားပါ။
